name: Sophon
description: Give your agent physical eyes and hands: inject keyboard/mouse into a machine that has the Sophon dongle plugged in, and read back what is on its screen.
description_zh: 让你的 Agent 长出实体手眼：操作插着 Sophon 硬件棒的机器，并读回它的屏幕画面。
description_en: Give your agent physical eyes and hands: inject keyboard/mouse into a machine that has the Sophon dongle plugged in, and read back what is on its screen.
author: wangeek
examples: 看这台机器的屏幕现在是什么
在那台电脑上打开记事本，输入一行字
用 Sophon 帮我操作插着硬件棒的机器
